csv_project_name: A/E for Public Address System Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: Design Services for the Public Address System Replacement. This project will implement a new PA system, expand the fiber and network infrastructure at Reclamation Plant Nos. 1 and 2, and expand to seven coastal pump stations. The upgrade will replace the aging system, which no longer meets operational needs due to limited coverage and outdated functionality. The new PA system will leverage Ethernet/IP-based technology and will be fully integrated with OC SAN s existing emergency communication platforms, including mass notification systems, to enhance reliability, scalability, and safety.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering

short_description: Design services for replacing and expanding a public address communication system.
project_location: Fountain Valley, California, USA; Reclamation Plant Nos. 1 and 2 and seven coastal pump stations in Orange County.

services: A/E design services for public address system replacement; requested disciplines include architecture services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, and civil engineering.
